summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-N2 admits no external crate. academic-knowledge-state links academic-domain, academic-ledger, academic-lecture-document, academic-repository-classification, serde and thiserror as product edges, and academic-capture, academic-consent, academic-model-run, academic-policy, academic-repository, academic-repository-analysis, academic-repository-correlation, academic-transcription, academic-untrusted-content, serde_json, tempfile, trybuild and uuid as dev edges, all covered by earlier reviewed receipts, and adds one workspace path package. Nothing links into a product binary that was not already there: the four workspace product edges are path packages this repository already builds, and serde and thiserror were admitted by the phase 1 receipt. Build-time-only additions are zero -- there is no build script, no proc macro beyond serde's and thiserror's, and no code generator.
summary.added_workspace_path_package_note: academic-knowledge-state is the P2-N2 boundary: section 13.1's six-level ladder with its five facets, section 13.2's eight evidence-to-ceiling rows, section 13.4's four deterministic eligibility checks, the KnowledgeStateAssertion that is always a new version, the append-only history a retraction extends, and the review card a user-confirmed state opens instead of accepting an AI adjustment. It is a separate package from academic-domain because the ladder's inputs reach three boundaries -- a P2-L4 lecture document, a P2-R4 project stance and P2-M3's conflict vocabulary -- that academic-domain sits below and cannot depend on without a cycle. It is a separate package from academic-ledger because a KnowledgeStateAssertion is an aggregate over evidence rather than a claim, and the ledger owns claim resolution.

no_second_ladder_note: Section 13.1's MasteryLevel and section 13.3's FreshnessBand were declared by P2-C1 in academic-domain and this task declares neither again: what it adds is LADDER, the same six in section 13.1's own row order, and rung, a total match with no wildcard arm, so a seventh level is a compile error here rather than a value some list quietly fails to mention. Section 30.3's conflict vocabulary was fixed by P2-M3 and this task emits academic_ledger::ConflictReason::NewEvidenceConflict rather than a second token. Section 17.3's evidence ladder and section 18's classifications were fixed by P2-R2 and P2-R4, and section 13.2's fourth and seventh rows are read out of a ConceptStance's ObservedProof -- which exists only for a P2-R2 finding at EvidenceTier::Observed -- rather than out of a heuristic here. Section 12.5's document was fixed by P2-L4, and a TeachingSite is a node of a real LectureDocument rather than a caller's string.

direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-domain: MasteryLevel, FreshnessBand, ConfidencePermille, ContentDigest, EntityId, EvidenceId, ModelRunId, ScopeId, TimestampMillis, Actor, Claim, ClaimObject, EpistemicStatus, EvidenceItem, DomainError and entity_registry::EntityKind. The ladder and the freshness bands are that crate's and are measured against it rather than copied beside it. ADR-003's Claim::validate_for_actor is what makes UserConfirmation user-only: every automatic actor variant fails that matrix when it attempts the USER_EXPLICIT/USER_CONFIRMED pairing. Section 7.4's EntityKind is why a FIELD or an ALIAS cannot carry a personal mastery -- the same two tiers P2-R4 refuses, refused here by the first eligibility check.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-ledger: ConflictReason and its canonical NEW_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT token. Section 13.4's `사용자 확인과 새 evidence가 충돌` is the conflict section 30.3 already resolved, and section 34.2's row for this failure names the same string as the display, so the card this crate opens carries P2-M3's value rather than a second vocabulary. This edge is what makes `there is no second conflict token` a graph fact.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-lecture-document: LectureDocument, DocumentId and NodeId. Section 13.2's first row is `transcript에서 meaningful teaching`, and TeachingSite::in_document answers only for a node the given document holds, so a caller with only a name has no teaching evidence at all. That is P2-R4's `CurrentBasis cannot be built from a label`, applied to the lecture lane.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-classification: ConceptStance, ObservedProof and GoalScope. Section 13.2's fourth and seventh rows are the same repository read two ways and the difference is ConceptStance::observed: ProjectUse::of_stance answers only for a stance carrying an ObservedProof and DependencyOnly::of_stance only for one that carries none, so the pair is exhaustive over a stance and neither is a heuristic in this crate.

dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-capture: P2-L2's begin, its journal and its preflight readings, so the manifest the acceptance suite builds a document over is the file the real capture surface wrote.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-consent: P2-L2's consent ledger, capture request and permission scope, because a capture that is not permitted writes no journal and the fixture must pass the same gate a real one does.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-model-run: CalibrationRegistry and its dataset types, for both lanes: P2-L3's confidence interpretation and P2-R2's OBSERVED rungs each require a fresh calibration before a segment or a finding exists.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-policy: ContentDigest, for the analysis policy hash a P2-R1 snapshot request carries.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository: P2-R1's capture_local and SnapshotRequest, so every project corpus is a frozen snapshot that passed the permission and secret gate rather than a fabricated one.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-analysis: P2-R2's EvidenceLadder, AnalysisInput, Subject and Finding, so the difference between an observed use and an installed dependency is that crate's decision and not this suite's.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-correlation: P2-R3's correlate and CorrelationInput, which is the only route from findings to the relation edges P2-R4 reads.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-transcription: P2-L3's run, its provider contract and its transcript lineage, so a document node maps a segment of a real transcript.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-untrusted-content: SourceIndex, which P2-R1's capture_local returns and P2-R2's AnalysisInput::of checks every unit against.
dev_workspace_dependencies.serde_json: The assertion schema round-trip. Section 13.1's schema has to survive serialization with every field and reference identical, and the FLUENT gate has to survive it too, which is checked by removing the fluency record from the wire object and observing the refusal.
dev_workspace_dependencies.tempfile: The directory a P2-L2 journal is written to. It is a dev edge only; no product file of this crate names it or any other filesystem type.
dev_workspace_dependencies.trybuild: The compile-fail suite. Section 13's promotions are types, and the eight cases under crates/knowledge-state/tests/compile_fail assert that each refusal is a program that does not compile with a committed diagnostic. The cases live in this package rather than in academic-scenario's suite because this crate reaches academic-ledger and scenario_crate_has_no_writer_dependency refuses academic-scenario that crate through a dev edge as much as a product one.
dev_workspace_dependencies.uuid: Deterministic UUIDv7-shaped fixture identities. Every identifier in the suite is a SHA-256 of the fixture's own name with the version and variant nibbles set, so no identity is a function of a clock.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-knowledge-state is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It owns section 13's knowledge state and, for each rule, the value that does not exist rather than the check somebody has to remember to run: AutomaticLevel has five variants and no Fluent, so an automatic projection cannot name the level section 13.1 reserves for a user confirmation; FluentAuthorization takes a repeated cross-context proof and a verified UserConfirmation by value and is the only argument that makes MasteryLevel::Fluent reachable; UserConfirmation's one constructor runs ADR-003's actor matrix, so a model run cannot mint one; CourseGradeSignal has no concept field and no ConceptEvidence variant, so a grade cannot be attributed to a concept at all; EligibleEvidence has one producer and project takes only those, so evidence that failed one of section 13.4's four checks has no value of the type a projection accepts; and KnowledgeStateAssertion has no setter, no public field and no &mut self method, so a correction is a new version whose identity binds its predecessor. Its dependency set is minimal and the edges it does not have are the point: no academic-store, so no assertion can reach the canonical writer and no migration is added; no academic-worker and no academic-egress-boundary, so nothing in its closure can launch a process or stage a payload.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, opens no file, reads no clock, declares no foreign function, reads no environment variable, spawns no process, and runs no build script. It spells no std::fs, std::net, std::process, std::env or std::time name at all: every artifact and every instant arrives as an argument. the_state_crate_reads_no_clock_and_opens_nothing in crates/knowledge-state/tests/knowledge_state_scans.rs compares the whole set of its use items, the whole set of the two-segment paths it reaches through a crate root, and the whole set of the macros it invokes against pinned inventories in both directions, and runs a whole-identifier pass for filesystem, clock and transport constructs over every product file. Five separate injections that spell none of the forbidden tokens were each observed failing a scan: an inline std::path::Path metadata call with no use item, an option_env! environment read, a std::fmt::Write import aliased inside a function body, a Vec<u8> field under the name annotation, and a public &mut self setter. Its link closure holds nothing that can open a socket beyond libc, which reaches it through academic-policy's bundled SQLite by way of academic-repository-classification. Every document, capture, transcript, snapshot, stance, claim and assertion in its test tree is synthetic and built in process; no real lecture or repository is read and no network call is made.
advisory_path: Unchanged. Every external crate academic-knowledge-state links was admitted by an earlier receipt and is triaged through that receipt's advisory path. serde and thiserror were admitted by the phase 1 receipt; serde_json, tempfile, trybuild and uuid are already-admitted dev dependencies of other workspace packages. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request.
